name: Structure
overview: Scripture reveals that God’s design for structure encompasses both divine order and practical governance, as seen in Deuteronomy 17:8 where God directs judgment to a chosen place, emphasizing His authority in legal matters. The spiritual structure of the believer’s life is also vital, with Romans 12:2 urging transformation through the renewing of the mind to discern God’s perfect will. In the context of the church, wise and circumspect living (Ephesians 5:15) reflects the importance of orderly conduct, while Matthew 6:33 prioritizes seeking God's kingdom and righteousness as the foundation for all else. These verses collectively affirm that structure, whether in church leadership or personal walk, is rooted in submission to God’s sovereign order and holiness.
